name: Glacier National Park
policyReason: Pets are allowed only in developed areas such as campgrounds, picnic areas and along roads.
summary: Pets are allowed only in developed areas such as campgrounds, picnic areas and along roads.

excerpts.quote: Pets are not permitted on trails, along lake shores outside of developed locations, in the backcountry, or in any building.

dogRules.text: Allowed in frontcountry campgrounds, picnic areas, parking areas and along roads.
Allowed in boats on lakes where motorboats are permitted.
Leashed dogs may use the Apgar to West Glacier bike path when free of snow.
Roads closed to cars count as backcountry trails: no dogs.
